caption: Figure 13.2: Parameterizing a design region with MaterialGrid and wrapping AdjointSimulation as a differentiable JAX primitive via jax_simulation. Left: MaterialGrid maps pixel densities ρ ∈ [0, 1] between eps_min and eps_max onto the staggered ieps edge midpoints of SolverFIT3D via trilinear interpolation (and maps edge sensitivities back via its exact transpose), with optional symmetry=('x',) and extrude_axis='z'. Right: the end-to-end jax.value_and_grad optimization loop combining conic_filter, tanh_projection, simulate = jax_simulation(sim), and monitor readout.

Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: forward state and primary grid quantities in blue, adjoint state and backward-pass quantities in orange, exact/structural operators in dark grey, design parameterization and projection items in green, failure or high-cost items in red.
